{{Quote|So tell me, Cooker, how did you get that name?''"<br />"''Well, I usually target the power cells of battle droids. I like to watch them&hellip;''uh''&hellip;burn.|Kit Fisto and Cooker|<ref name="The Gauntlet of Death" />}}
'''Cooker''', known also by the number '''2242''', was a [[Clone sharpshooter/Legends|clone sniper]] in [[Green Company/Legends|Green Company]], a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Company/Legends|unit]], during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. When [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] forces [[Capture of Rishi|captured]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]] and its [[Exonium/Legends|exonium]] [[Mining/Legends|mines]] around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], Green Company was dispatched to the planet in order to protect the [[Rishii/Legends|native inhabitants]] and reconquer the mines. After an [[Battle of Rishi (Clone Wars)|unsuccessful attack]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] formulated a plan to defeat the Geonosians and ordered Green Company's [[Unidentified clone trooper commander (Rishi)|clone commander]] to provide [[Gender/Legends|him]] with his best [[Sniper/Legends|sharpshooter]].

The [[Clone Commander/Legends|commander]] selected Cooker, who took up position opposite the canyon that led to the entrance of the mines. Following Fisto's instructions, Cooker aimed at the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi's]] shoulder and [[Laser/Legends|fired]] continuously; Fisto used his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] to deflect Cooker's shots into the Geonosians. After all of the Geonosians in the canyon had been [[Death/Legends|killed]], the Geonosian [[Troop/Legends|troops]] inside the mines attacked Fisto with an [[LR1K sonic cannon/Legends|LR1K sonic cannon]], knocking the Jedi to the ground, but Cooker destroyed the cannon with a well-aimed shot. The rest of the Republic forces&mdash;along with some native Rishii warriors&mdash;then arrived and attacked the mines, forcing the remaining Geonosians within to flee.

==Biography==
{{Quote|It was the power of mind that made this victory possible. Plus a little help from a friend.|Kit Fisto, on Cooker|<ref name="The Gauntlet of Death" />}}
[[Clone trooper/Legends|Clone trooper]] 2242 was a [[Clone sharpshooter/Legends|clone sniper]] with the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]].<ref name="The Gauntlet of Death" /> 2242 was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]]<ref name="CloneDatabank" /> as a [[Cloning/Legends|clone]]<ref name="The Gauntlet of Death" /> of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]].<ref name="CloneDatabank" /> During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], 2242 was known by the name "Cooker" for being able to consistently hit the [[Power cell/Legends|power cells]] of [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]], resulting in the combustion of the [[Droid/Legends|droids]].<ref name="The Gauntlet of Death" /> Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="SW Annual 2011">''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]''</ref> [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] forces [[Capture of Rishi|invaded]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]] and&mdash;in order to get the [[Mineral/Legends|mineral]] needed to power their [[Sonic weapon/Legends|sonic weapons]]&mdash;took control of the [[Exonium/Legends|exonium]] [[Mining/Legends|mines]] on the planet. The [[Company/Legends|unit]] to which Cooker belonged, [[Green Company/Legends|Green Company]], was dispatched to protect the native [[Rishii/Legends|Rishii]] and was ordered not to attack until a [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] arrived. However, [[Rishii/Legends|Rishii]] [[Chief/Legends|Chieftain]] [[Gwarrk]] ordered the clone [[Troop/Legends|troopers]] to [[Battle of Rishi (Clone Wars)|assail]] the mines, because [[Gender/Legends|his]] people needed the exonium to prepare their food when the ground began to frost.<ref name="The Gauntlet of Death" />

[[File:Cooker_takes_position.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Cooker takes up position across from the canyon.]]
The clones' attack was unsuccessful due to the Geonosians' better position, and soon a retreat was ordered by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]], who had just arrived on Rishi. Fisto then developed a plan to defeat the Geonosians and ordered Green Company's [[Unidentified clone trooper commander (Rishi)|clone commander]] to provide him with his best [[Sniper/Legends|sharpshooter]]; the [[Clone Commander/Legends|commander]] chose Cooker for the task. After inquiring after Cooker's nickname, Fisto approved the appointment. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] then went to the entrance of the mines, and Cooker, positioned on a ledge opposite the entrance, told Fisto that he could not help him, because he had no line of sight to the well-entrenched enemy from his position.<ref name="The Gauntlet of Death" />

Fisto answered that Cooker was supposed to target the Jedi himself and [[Laser/Legends|fire]] continuously at his shoulder. Cooker was shocked and told Fisto that he could not shoot at him, but the Jedi explained to him that he would deflect Cooker's [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] shots with his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] at the Geonosians, since he couldn't deflect their sonic weapons. When the Geonosians began to attack the Jedi, Fisto ordered Cooker to open fire. Cooker complied, and with their combined efforts, all of the enemy [[Troop/Legends|troops]] in the canyon were soon [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the deflected shots.<ref name="The Gauntlet of Death" />

Fisto then noticed the massive doors of the mines opening and hoped that this meant a surrender of the Confederate forces. This proved not to be the case, as the Geonosians revealed an [[LR1K sonic cannon/Legends|LR1K sonic cannon]] and attacked Fisto with it, knocking him to the ground. At that moment, Cooker contacted Fisto via [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] and told the Jedi to stay down. Demonstrating his sniping skills, Cooker fired a single shot directly down the barrel of the Confederate weapon, destroying the cannon. The rest of the Republic forces and the Rishii warriors then attacked the mines, forcing the remaining Geonosians to flee. Afterward, Gwarrk acknowledged that Fisto was very powerful, to which the Jedi replied that two factors had made this victory possible: the power of his mind and Cooker's help.<ref name="The Gauntlet of Death" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|You must be a fine shot to consistently hit a droid's power cell.|Kit Fisto, on Cooker's sniping skills|<ref name="The Gauntlet of Death" />}}
Cooker was considered to be a talented sharpshooter, able to consistently hit power cells of Separatist droids; he mentioned enjoyment at watching the droids subsequently burn. Kit Fisto found Cooker's skills exceptional and commended him for that. Cooker did not want to shoot at his [[General/Legends|general]] and later saved Fisto's life when the Jedi was targeted by a sonic cannon.<ref name="The Gauntlet of Death" /> As a Jango Fett clone, Cooker stood 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall and had [[Color/Legends|tan]] skin.<ref name="CloneDatabank" />

==Equipment==
As a sniper, Cooker carried a [[DC-15A blaster rifle/Legends|DC-15A blaster rifle]]. Cooker wore white [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase I clone trooper armor]] with a scratch mark across the right side of his [[Helmet/Legends|helmet's]] visor.<ref name="The Gauntlet of Death" />

==Behind the scenes==
Cooker first appeared in [[Dark Horse Comics]]' [[2009]] [[Free Comic Book Day]] [[Star Wars comic books|issue]] [[The Gauntlet of Death|''The Clone Wars: The Gauntlet of Death'']], which was written by [[Henry Gilroy]] and illustrated by [[Ramón Pérez|Ramón K. Pérez]].<ref name="The Gauntlet of Death" />
